verses: Apney boht hi buland Allah kay naam ki pakeezgi biyan ker
Jiss ney peda kiya aur sahih saalim banaya
Aur jiss ney (theek thaak) andaza kiya aur phir raah dikhaee
Aur jiss ney taza ghaas peda ki
Phir uss ney uss ko (sikha ker) siyah kora ker diya
Hum tujhay parhaein gay phir to na bhoolay ga
Magar jo kuch Allah chahaye. Woh zahir aur posheedah ko janta hai
Hum aap kay liye aasani peda ker den gay
To aap naseehat kertay rahen agar naseehat kuch faeedah dey
Darney wala to naseehat ley ga
(haan) bad bakht uss say gurez keray ga
Jo bari aag mein jaye ga
Jahan phir na woh maray ga na jiye ga, (balkay)yeh halat nazah mein para rahey ga)
Be-shak uss ney falah paali jo pak hogaya
Aur jiss ney apney rab ka naam yaad rakha aur namaz parhta raha
Lekin tum to duniya ki zindagi ko tarjeeh detay ho
Aur aakhirat boht behtar aur boht baqa wali hai
Yeh baaten pehli kitabon mein bhi hain
(yani) Ibrahim aur Musa ki kitabon mein
